correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the uniform parent gives three exact coupled moment recurrences with independently checked base values; the resulting covariance recurrence uniquely yields the closed product polynomial. Factorization as a Poisson-binomial generating polynomial and Newton strict log-concavity proves the one-switch sign law for every n≥3. Independent rational enumeration for all recursive trees through n=10 plus recurrence checks through n=65 and signs through n=250 passed 4687 exact comparisons; finite computations are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The entire level-by-level leaf–profile covariance polynomial and its one-switch sign law were not found among direct exact level-level covariance, degree-count covariance, depth-congruence, labeled-vertex, or own-record comparisons. The degree-one and weighted-depth projections are known separately and are excluded from independent novelty assertions. Full older generating functions could conceivably imply the formula implicitly; that residual priority risk is recorded, so this is a best-knowledge rather than a uniqueness certificate.
residual_risks: Implicit recoverability from an older bivariate generating function for leaf count marked jointly with depth levels has not been excluded across all historical work.

value.rationale: The depth profile measures how a growing hierarchy distributes mass by generation; total leaves measure terminal branching. Their full mixed dependence is natural but cannot be reconstructed from marginal level-level and degree-degree covariances. An exact product and a unique sign reversal explain the coexistence of positive shallow-depth and negative deep-depth associations and recover two independently known aggregate projections. No downstream theorem is assumed.
